name: Cursor Smith
description: Forge your text cursor — styles, colors, smooth motion, blinking, particle effects, and a torch spotlight.
instructions: Cursor Smith replaces Thymer's text caret with a canvas-rendered cursor. Pick a style, tune the look, and layer on motion and effects — everything applies live. Save a look as a preset and share it with a code. Ported from Cursor-Smith by SadSnake1 (MIT).
author: @akaready
